question: On a real, reachable, deterministic local substrate with no browser, no docker, and no LLM key, what is the measured per-span witnessed-determinism fraction of a task execution, and does a no-memory compiled executor with a selective deopt-to-agent ratchet (compile the witnessed-deterministic spans, hand the residual to a model, recompile as the residual shrinks) achieve lower amortized end-to-end cost than inherited-mechanism execution at matched correctness, with the inheritance-ablation arm (emptied registry) as the mandatory null and the incumbent shipped kernel as an additional arm?
hypothesis: A no-memory compiled executor with a deopt-to-agent ratchet will achieve lower amortized end-to-end cost than SPIDER's inherited-mechanism execution at matched correctness on a deterministic local substrate, because the per-span witnessed-determinism fraction is high enough that compiling deterministic spans and only deferring genuinely novel spans to a model is more efficient than maintaining a full inheritance infrastructure.
falsifier: If the no-memory deopt-to-agent executor matches or beats inherited-mechanism execution at matched correctness and equal or lower amortized cost, then SPIDER's central premise (that cumulative inheritance infrastructure pays for itself) is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING and the architecture must change to non-inheriting execution.

baselines.B-INHERITED-SPIDER: Current SPIDER kernel with distilled mechanisms in registry (src/spider/kernel.py) - the incumbent shipped kernel
baselines.B-NO-MEMORY-DETERMINISTIC: No-memory deterministic executor: compiles witnessed-deterministic spans, deopts residual spans to a model oracle, recompiles as residual shrinks (ratchet). This is the primary test arm.
baselines.B-COLD-EXPLORATION: Cold exploration with empty registry (inheritance ablation) - MANDATORY NULL CONTROL. Same substrate, same tasks, no inherited mechanisms.

positive_control.description: Synthetic task with 100% witnessed-deterministic spans (all spans repeat identically across episodes). The deopt ratchet should compile all spans on first episode and achieve zero model calls thereafter. Expected: 1.0 determinism fraction, amortized cost approaches compile-only cost.

null_control.description: Synthetic task with 0% witnessed-deterministic spans (every span is unique per episode). The deopt ratchet should never compile, always deopt to model. Expected: 0.0 determinism fraction, cost equals cold exploration plus compile overhead.

measurement_validity.substrate: Real, reachable, deterministic local HTTP service (stdlib only, no Flask/FastAPI/BrowserGym/docker/Chromium). A-PROBE from parent handoff demonstrated stdlib HTTP service works.
measurement_validity.availability_observation: Infrastructure availability recorded as observation with explicit smallest-next-action, not as blocking falsifier. If substrate unavailable, record exact failure and smallest unblocker.
measurement_validity.per_span_unit: Measurement at individual work-span level (not task-family aggregate). A span = contiguous sequence of actions with identical state-action signature across episodes.
measurement_validity.determinism_definition: A span is witnessed-deterministic if its (state, action, next_state) tuple is identical across >=2 episodes with the same intent. Determinism fraction = deterministic_spans / total_spans.
measurement_validity.cost_accounting: Amortized end-to-end cost = (compile_cost + sum(model_call_costs) + sum(execution_costs)) / episodes. Model call cost measured in abstract units (1 unit per deopt invocation). Execution cost = 1 unit per span executed. Compile cost = 1 unit per unique span compiled.
measurement_validity.correctness_criterion: Task success rate must be >= 0.95 for all arms. Matched correctness enforced by only comparing arms that achieve >= 0.95 success.
measurement_validity.residual_novelty_tracking: Report determinism fraction as function of episode index (learning curve) and as function of span novelty (first-seen vs repeated).

decision_rule.primary:
Three-way outcome on amortized cost at matched correctness (success >= 0.95) over 50 episodes:
  - DEOPT_DOMINATES: deopt_ratchet_cost < inherited_cost AND deopt_ratchet_cost < cold_cost
  - DEOPT_TIES: |deopt_ratchet_cost - inherited_cost| <= 0.05 * max(deopt_ratchet_cost, inherited_cost) AND both < cold_cost
  - DEOPT_LOSES: deopt_ratchet_cost >= inherited_cost OR cold_cost <= min(deopt_ratchet_cost, inherited_cost)

Falsifier trigger: If DEOPT_DOMINATES or DEOPT_TIES, then FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for SPIDER's central premise.
secondary: Report per-span determinism distribution (histogram, mean, median, CI) across episodes
Report determinism fraction vs episode index (learning curve)
Report residual-novelty dependence: cost breakdown by span novelty tier (never-seen, seen-once, seen-multiple)
Report infrastructure availability as observation with smallest-next-action if any component fails

product_consequence_positive: If DEOPT_DOMINATES or DEOPT_TIES: SPIDER's central inheritance premise is falsified in this setting. Architecture must pivot to non-inheriting compiled execution with deopt ratchet. Product kernel would be replaced by a compile+deopt runtime. C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY claim updated to REJECTED or SUPERSEDED.
product_consequence_negative: If DEOPT_LOSES: Inherited-mechanism execution remains justified. The deopt ratchet is a valid baseline but not superior. C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY remains HYPOTHESIS/EXPERIMENTAL. Next experiment should test whether inherited mechanisms provide value on top of compiled deterministic spans (hybrid architecture).

estimated_cost.compute: Low - pure Python, stdlib HTTP, no external APIs, no browser, no LLM calls (model oracle simulated)
estimated_cost.wall_time: ~5 minutes for 50 episodes x 3 arms x ~20 spans/episode

expected_information_gain: High - this is the first experiment testing the deopt ratchet architecture against SPIDER's inheritance architecture at the per-span level on a real substrate. The three-way decision rule directly addresses whether cumulative inheritance infrastructure pays for itself. A valid negative (DEOPT_DOMINATES/TIES) would be the most informative result in the program to date.
